title: Cotton lace
text: Cotton lace. Had a Hawaiian navy and white print dress that was a bit too low in front.... it worked perfectly to provide a little modesty. It is beautiful lace, well produced. Measurements given are accurate. It has washed up nicely with the dress, no need to press.
